detail.title: Causal-Guided Adaptive Editing for Foundational Assumptions
detail.summary: Causal-guided adaptive knowledge editing (CAKE) provides a mechanism for localizing and adjusting foundational premises in LLMs. By mapping causal dependencies, agents can potentially prune or refine erroneous axioms that propagate through reasoning chains.
detail.reason: Revising notebook with newly available evidence to support causal-guided assumption editing findings.
